law: HE CAN BUILD HIS OWN FACE (8/28), on the modelled head (rule 115h)
how: a person's face spec is a dict of these keys (any subset; missing keys are the default); the tool clamps it with the 2D panel's own anatomy rules, builds the head on the body, and DIRECTION's rig renders it. Every default together is the starred head, unchanged.

dials.label: FACE LENGTH
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the face below the head's centre stretches, the chin 5.8 mm a pixel (the neck stays in its collar)

dials.label: CRANIUM
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the skull above the centre stretches, the crown 5.8 mm a pixel

dials.label: FOREHEAD
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the width above the brow, 2.9 percent a pixel

dials.label: CHEEKS
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the width at the cheekbones, 2.3 percent a pixel

dials.label: JAW
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the width at the jaw's corner, 2.7 percent a pixel

dials.label: CHIN
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the chin's width, 3.75 percent a pixel

dials.label: BROW HEIGHT
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the brow ridge up or down, 5.8 mm a pixel (held under 15 mm)

dials.label: EYE HEIGHT
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the eyes and their sockets up or down, 5.8 mm a pixel (13 mm max)

dials.label: NOSE HEIGHT
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the nose up or down, 5.8 mm a pixel (18 mm max)

dials.label: MOUTH HEIGHT
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the mouth and lips up or down, 5.8 mm a pixel (14 mm max)

dials.label: EYE SPACING
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: each eye out from the middle, 3.5 mm a pixel (18 mm max)

dials.label: BROW LENGTH
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the brow ridge's length, 8.6 percent a pixel

dials.label: MOUTH WIDTH
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the mouth's width (and the speak-along shapes with it), 6.7 percent a pixel

dials.label: NOSE WIDTH
dials.units: the 64 px face's pixels (the alpha's FACE_SLIDERS)
dials.moves: the nose and its wings, 16.7 percent a pixel

parts.skin: a step of skin_light, skin_mid or skin_deep (records/target/BOHEMIA_STYLE_PALETTE.json)

identity_check: every dial at its default: F['identity'] is True and the warp is skipped, so the poacher, the thug and the crew's thirteen rebuild unchanged (measured 10/18d: the same vertex counts and materials, positions within 1.5e-8 m, the export's own run-to-run noise)
